record.field: Website: controllers, QWeb, Bootstrap, SCSS, PDF
Build the adoption pages of the website: the animals waiting for a family, their page and the adoption form.

field.name: description
field.p: The animal shelter Les 4 Pattes takes care of 15 cats, dogs, rabbits and birds. Ten of them are waiting for a family, but nobody knows it: the shelter has no adoption page on its website yet.

div.p: Development challenge: website. Complete the module trivia_animal_shelter: the models, the backend and the data are ready, the website is up to you. The TODOs of the code are numbered like the missions below, and give the details.
After a change of Python code, or a new file or record, update the modules (make update), then click Check: the tab Checker Report lists what is still missing.
The method _get_adoptable_animals(): the business logic of the pages.
💡 Keep the controllers thin: the checker tests the methods of the models directly.
A public page with a responsive grid of cards, one card per adoptable animal.

div.h6: 3 · The page of an animal controllers/main.py views/website_templates.xml
div.p: Each adoptable animal has its own page, at the URL animal.website_url, e.g. /adopt/rex-6.

div.h6: 4 · The adoption request models/shelter_adoption_request.py controllers/main.py views/website_templates.xml
div.p: A form on the page of the animal, posted to the website, which creates the request safely with _create_from_website(). Then adopt an animal yourself, as a visitor!
💡 Logged in, you are not a visitor: open the website in a private window.

div.h6: 5 · The style and the menu static/src/scss/shelter.scss __manifest__.py views/website_templates.xml
div.p: Cards styled by the SCSS file, declared in the assets of the website, and an Adopt menu on the website.
A PDF report, printable from an adoption request.
💡 In Odoo 20, the field report_file no longer exists: with it, the installation fails.

ul.li: Buttons to filter the animals by species.
An Animal of the week building block for the website editor.
